title: Large Language Models for AI Infrastructure
abstract: arXiv:2611.19061v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to design, optimize, and operate the infrastructure behind AI training and serving, yet the literature remains fragmented across hardware design, machine learning systems, electronic design automation, and high-performance computing. We present a comprehensive survey of LLM-assisted AI infrastructure across its lifecycle, from accelerator design and kernel engineering to compilation, deployment, operations, data management, and energy optimization. We organize the literature by the primary resource the LLM manages: artifact-centric methods for computational artifacts, operational-centric methods for deployment context and system state, and resource-centric methods for data and energy. These categories span the lifecycle and cover AI-specific concerns such as distributed-training configuration, inference serving, GPU-cluster scheduling, and data loading. translated_title: 面向AI基础设施的大语言模型
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正日益被用于设计、优化和运营AI训练与服务背后的基础设施，然而相关文献仍然分散于硬件设计、机器学习系统、电子设计自动化和高性能计算等多个领域。我们对LLM辅助的AI基础设施在其整个生命周期中的应用进行了全面综述，涵盖从加速器设计与内核工程到编译、部署、运维、数据管理以及能耗优化。我们按照LLM所管理的主要资源对文献进行组织分类：面向计算制品的以制品为中心的方法、面向部署环境与系统状态的以运维为中心的方法，以及面向数据与能源的以资源为中心的方法。这些类别贯穿整个生命周期，并覆盖了AI特有的问题，例如分布式训练配置、推理服务、GPU集群调度和数据加载。基于这一分类体系，我们……
tldr: 该论文提出了一套按LLM所管理资源分类的分类体系，对大语言模型在AI基础设施全生命周期（从加速器设计到能耗优化）中的应用进行了首次系统性综述。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first comprehensive survey of LLM-assisted AI infrastructure across its entire lifecycle, organized by a taxonomy of artifact-centric, operational-centric, and resource-centric methods.
